notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
Hi Everyone

We have just made a small update that addressed an issue that some users had with achievements as well as fixed up some of the art assets that were not quite up to the quality standards of the rest of the game. We are in the process of doing more small updates as well as fixing any issues as you report them. We are also mapping out and starting work on writing Frisky Business 2.

Thank you everyone for your support so far the reception has been amazing and we hope that you all continue to enjoy Frisky Business. 

Stay Frisky!

notes.title: Influencers + Content Creators ( DO NOT LOOK INSIDE :) )
notes.content:
Hi all, 

If you are an influencer or content creator on You Tube, Twitch etc feel free to request an early copy of the game by emailing info @ kbrosinc . com 

We will also be issuing all requests through keymailer.co

We support channels and websites of all sizes :) 

Best N&N 

And just for you because you are part of the community :)
